key_provisions_or_claims: PROV should develop a general AI topic page covering AI technologies and recordkeeping considerations
New policy advice on generative AI/LLMs should focus on record accuracy
Existing Approval Processes Policy covers decision-making AI with a transparency focus
Link external tools (NIST AI RMF Playbook, capAI, Algorithmic Impact Assessment, NSW AI Assurance Framework) as resources
Review advice once the Victorian AI Hub/CoE approach is available
annotation.summary_en: Public Record Office Victoria research paper recommending an approach to managing records created by or using AI. It reviews the EU AI Act, US AI Bill of Rights/NIST AI RMF and Australasian approaches, and recommends AI topic guidance, generative AI recordkeeping advice, and links to external assessment tools. The metadata title suggests a VLRC page, but the content is a PROV paper.
